en-US.name: V A S D Lunch
en-US.summary: Daily and weekly lunch menus for Verona Area School District.
en-US.description: Listen to spoken school lunch menus for the Verona Area School District (VASD). Ask what is for lunch for elementary school, middle school, or high school for today, tomorrow, yesterday, or next week.
examplePhrases: Alexa, open V A S D Lunch
Alexa, ask V A S D Lunch what's for lunch today for elementary school
Alexa, ask V A S D Lunch what's for lunch next week for middle school

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill by saying 'Alexa, open V A S D Lunch'. Respond with 'elementary', 'middle', or 'high school'. Or ask directly: 'Alexa, ask V A S D Lunch what's for lunch tomorrow for high school'.
